theorems.name: Submission.constancy_riesz_bounded_density_of_dominated_additive
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α), IsFiniteMeasure μ → ∀ (ν : Set α → ℝ) (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → (∀ A B : Set α, MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → Disjoint A B → ν (A ∪ B) = ν A + ν B) → (∀ A : Set α, MeasurableSet A → |ν A| ≤ C * μ.real A) → ∃ θ : α → ℝ, Measurable θ ∧ (∀ x, |θ x| ≤ C) ∧ ∀ A : Set α, MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫ x in A, θ x ∂μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
